description: Configuration for the ZAH2 magnetic door controller used as the primary gym entry gate. Members scan a dynamic QR code or tap an NFC card to gain access.

endpoint.description: Your backend edge function URL that the ZAH2 device POSTs to
endpoint.note: Deploy the zah-gate edge function and point the ZAH2 device to this URL

device_protocol.description: ZAH2 hardware sends JSON POST requests to your endpoint

heartbeat.trigger: Device sends cmd=0 periodically to verify server is alive

card_scan.trigger: Member scans QR code or taps NFC card

qr_code_encryption.description: Dynamic QR codes are AES-128-ECB encrypted and expire after 5 minutes
qr_code_encryption.key_source: Environment variable: QR_ENCRYPTION_KEY (also stored as ENCRYPTION_KEY in edge function)

validation.note: QR codes older than 5 minutes are rejected to prevent replay attacks

nfc_card_support.description: Members can also use physical NFC cards instead of QR codes
nfc_card_support.byte_order_handling: Both normal and byte-reversed order are checked (some readers reverse byte order: 3B40249B ↔ 9B24403B)

member_id_format.description: Member IDs are 8 uppercase hex characters used as the QR payload base
member_id_format.generation: generate_member_id() database function — random hex, collision-checked

checks_performed_in_order: 1. Decrypt QR payload (AES-128-ECB) and validate timestamp is within 5 minutes
2. If 8-char hex: check nfc_card_id match first, fallback to member_id lookup
3. Look up member profile by member_id (case-insensitive)
4. Check membership valid_from — reject if pass not started yet
5. Check membership expiry_date — reject if expired (compared at end of day)
6. Check membership status === "active" — reject if inactive
access_control_logic.no_membership_record: Access is GRANTED if no membership record exists (allows staff/admin accounts)
access_control_logic.null_expiry_date: Access is GRANTED — null expiry = unlimited (staff, lifetime members)

columns.notes: e.g. "QR access: A1B2C3D4" or "NFC card access: 3B40249B" or "REJECTED - Expired membership"

check_in_logging.note: Both granted AND denied access attempts are logged

environment_variables_required.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
environment_variables_required.description: Service role key for DB access (bypass RLS)

environment_variables_required.name: QR_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environment_variables_required.description: 16-character AES encryption key — MUST match the frontend key exactly

setup_checklist: 1. Deploy the zah-gate edge function to your backend
2. Set SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, and QR_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variables
3. Configure the ZAH2 device to POST to your edge function URL
4. Ensure the ZAH2 device uses cmd=0 for heartbeat and cmd=1 for card scans
5. In the frontend, use generateEncryptedQrPayload(memberId) from memberQr.ts to generate QR values
6. Members with 8-char hex member_id in their profile will have working QR access
7. Assign nfc_card_id in profiles for NFC card access
